person.description: Roman Mednitzer is a senior systems and platform engineer in Vienna, Austria, focused on infrastructure integration, reliable operations and recovery.
interests: Listening to industrial, EBM and dark ambient music
person.introduction: I’m Roman, a systems and platform engineer based in Vienna. I work across infrastructure layers, connecting requirements and hands-on integration with reliable operation, troubleshooting and recovery.
person.outlook: That curiosity comes with a need to understand the mechanisms and consequences. I like ambitious ideas and difficult problems, but I want assumptions made visible and room to change my mind. Open systems and digital sovereignty matter to me because being able to inspect, adapt and retain control of technology is part of having meaningful agency.
personalPerspective: I tend to follow a question across disciplines rather than stop where one field ends. AI, robotics and cybernetics interest me because they connect engineering with questions about intelligence, identity and how people might live. Human augmentation and space exploration appeal to the same curiosity: what could we become capable of, and what would it take to get there?

That curiosity comes with a need to understand the mechanisms and consequences. I like ambitious ideas and difficult problems, but I want assumptions made visible and room to change my mind. Open systems and digital sovereignty matter to me because being able to inspect, adapt and retain control of technology is part of having meaningful agency.
Hard science fiction gives me another way to explore those possibilities and their consequences. My musical tastes lean towards industrial, electronic body music (EBM) and dark ambient.

professionalWork.background: I have around ten years of production infrastructure experience across managed services, enterprise infrastructure and a regulated medical-device environment. My work spans Linux, virtualisation, storage, networking and container platforms.
professionalWork.approach: I work with developers, operations, security teams and service owners to clarify requirements, resolve integration problems and make systems maintainable. I value clear responsibilities, reproducible configuration, useful documentation and evidence from actual operation.

capabilities.description: Linux systems, virtualisation, storage and networking, including production work with Kubernetes and OpenShift. I focus on how components fit together and behave as an operational system.
Monitoring, incident analysis and controlled change, with backup administration, documented restore tests and rollback planning. Recovery needs to be demonstrated, not assumed.
Selected automation with Ansible and Terraform, alongside runbooks and operational handover. My experience also includes ISMS documentation, business continuity and ISO/IEC 27001 audit preparation.

personalLab.description: My private lab gives me room to explore AI infrastructure and automation, test integrations, and rehearse migrations and recovery. Some deliberately complex experiments examine how AI agents handle execution feedback and long contexts.
